en.fail.image-critically-large: The listed images drop below 500 KB (content) in a fresh lab run.
en.fail.image-legacy-format: The listed images are served as WebP or AVIF in a fresh fetch.
en.fail.image-oversized-for-display: The listed images are at most about twice the displayed size.
en.fail.image-too-large: The listed images are below the guideline in a fresh lab run.
en.fail.mobile-font-too-small: The share of text below 12 px drops under 20% in the mobile lab run.
en.fail.mobile-horizontal-scroll: The mobile lab run reports no horizontal overflow.
en.fail.mobile-tap-targets-small: The mobile lab run finds fewer than three undersized tap targets.
en.fail.page-weight-heavy: Total transferred bytes in a fresh lab run drop below 3 MiB.
en.fail.render-blocking-resources: The number of render-blocking resources drops below four in a fresh lab run.
en.fail.static-assets-no-cache: The listed files answer with a max-age of at least one day.
en.fail.third-party-heavy: The third-party share falls below the threshold in a fresh lab run.
en.fail.too-many-requests: The request count in a fresh lab run is 100 or fewer.
en.fail.uncompressed-text-resources: The listed resources answer with a content-encoding header in a fresh fetch.

en.finding.image-critically-large: Some images are far larger than the size guideline for their kind (thumbnail 200 KB, content 500 KB, hero 700 KB).
en.finding.image-legacy-format: Some large images are served as JPEG or PNG. WebP or AVIF is usually smaller. This is a heuristic.
en.finding.image-oversized-for-display: Some images are much larger (in pixels) than the space they are shown in. This is a heuristic.
en.finding.image-too-large: Some images are larger than the size guideline for their kind (thumbnail 100 KB, content 200 KB, hero 300 KB).
en.finding.mobile-font-too-small: A large share of the text is set below 12 px on a phone. This share is a heuristic.
en.finding.mobile-horizontal-scroll: On a phone-sized screen the page is wider than the screen, so it scrolls sideways.
en.finding.mobile-tap-targets-small: Several tap targets are smaller than 24 by 24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 AA). The count threshold is a heuristic.
en.finding.page-weight-heavy: The page transfers more than 3 MiB in total. This limit is a heuristic, not a search engine rule.
en.finding.render-blocking-resources: Four or more stylesheets or scripts block the first paint. This count is a heuristic.
en.finding.static-assets-no-cache: Several static files (scripts, styles, images, fonts) are cacheable for less than one day or not at all.
en.finding.third-party-heavy: Third-party hosts account for a large share of the requests or bytes. This is a heuristic.
en.finding.too-many-requests: The page makes more than 100 network requests. This limit is a heuristic.
en.finding.uncompressed-text-resources: Text resources (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON) larger than 1 KiB are served without compression.

en.rec.cwv-cls-needs-improvement: Look for quick wins in the metric's main contributors.
en.rec.cwv-cls-poor: Profile the page and fix the largest contributor; re-measure with field data.
en.rec.cwv-inp-needs-improvement: Look for quick wins in the metric's main contributors.
en.rec.cwv-inp-poor: Profile the page and fix the largest contributor; re-measure with field data.
en.rec.cwv-lcp-needs-improvement: Look for quick wins in the metric's main contributors.
en.rec.cwv-lcp-poor: Profile the page and fix the largest contributor; re-measure with field data.
en.rec.image-critically-large: Resize and compress these images first, and prefer WebP or AVIF.
en.rec.image-legacy-format: Serve WebP or AVIF (with a JPEG fallback in a picture element if needed).
en.rec.image-oversized-for-display: Serve the image at the displayed size (with srcset for sharper screens).
en.rec.image-too-large: Compress the listed images, or serve a smaller size with srcset.
en.rec.mobile-font-too-small: Use a base font size of about 16 px and avoid text below 12 px.
en.rec.mobile-horizontal-scroll: Find the element wider than the viewport and make it responsive (max-width: 100%).
en.rec.mobile-tap-targets-small: Enlarge buttons and links to at least 24 px, ideally 48 px, or add spacing around them.
en.rec.page-weight-heavy: Cut the largest transfers first (images, scripts, fonts, video); lazy-load below-the-fold media.
en.rec.render-blocking-resources: Defer or async non-critical scripts and inline the critical CSS.
en.rec.static-assets-no-cache: Send Cache-Control with a long max-age for fingerprinted static files.
en.rec.third-party-heavy: Review each third-party tag; remove what is unused and load the rest after the main content.
en.rec.too-many-requests: Bundle and defer scripts and styles, inline tiny assets, drop unused third-party tags.
en.rec.uncompressed-text-resources: Enable gzip or Brotli on the server or CDN for text responses.
en.finding.page-carbon-high: A page view is estimated to emit a lot of CO2 for its transferred data (Sustainable Web Design rating at or below the threshold). This is a model estimate, not a measurement.
en.rec.page-carbon-high: Transfer less data per view: compress and resize images, drop unused scripts and fonts, cache static assets, and consider a green host.

tr.rec.image-critically-large: Önce bu görselleri yeniden boyutlandırıp sıkıştırın, WebP veya AVIF tercih edin.
tr.rec.image-legacy-format: WebP veya AVIF sunun (gerekirse picture öğesinde JPEG yedeğiyle).
tr.rec.image-oversized-for-display: Görseli gösterildiği boyutta sunun (daha keskin ekranlar için srcset ile).
tr.rec.image-too-large: Listelenen görselleri sıkıştırın veya srcset ile daha küçük boyut sunun.
tr.rec.mobile-font-too-small: Yaklaşık 16 px temel yazı boyutu kullanın, 12 px altı metinden kaçının.
tr.rec.mobile-horizontal-scroll: Görünüm alanından geniş öğeyi bulup duyarlı yapın (max-width: 100%).
tr.rec.mobile-tap-targets-small: Düğme ve bağlantıları en az 24 px, mümkünse 48 px yapın veya çevrelerine boşluk ekleyin.
tr.rec.page-weight-heavy: Önce en büyük aktarımları azaltın (görseller, script'ler, fontlar, video); ekran altı medyayı geç yükleyin.
tr.rec.render-blocking-resources: Kritik olmayan script'leri defer/async yapın ve kritik CSS'i satır içine alın.
tr.rec.static-assets-no-cache: Parmak izli statik dosyalar için uzun max-age'li Cache-Control gönderin.
tr.rec.third-party-heavy: Her üçüncü taraf etiketini gözden geçirin; kullanılmayanı kaldırın, kalanını ana içerikten sonra yükleyin.
tr.rec.too-many-requests: Script ve stilleri birleştirip erteleyin, küçük varlıkları satır içine alın, kullanılmayan üçüncü taraf etiketlerini kaldırın.
tr.rec.uncompressed-text-resources: Sunucuda veya CDN'de metin yanıtları için gzip veya Brotli'yi etkinleştirin.
tr.finding.page-carbon-high: Bir sayfa görüntülemesinin aktardığı veri nedeniyle yüksek CO2 salımına yol açtığı tahmin ediliyor (Sustainable Web Design notu eşikte ya da daha kötü). Bu bir ölçüm değil, model tahminidir.
tr.rec.page-carbon-high: Görüntüleme başına daha az veri aktarın: görselleri sıkıştırıp boyutlandırın, kullanılmayan script ve fontları kaldırın, statik dosyaları önbelleğe alın ve yeşil enerjili bir barındırma hizmeti düşünün.
